resources.string: To find media & subtitles on your device, we require \'All File Access\'.

Tapping ALLOW ACCESS opens Android\'s system-level All files access setting so FAZA Player can discover local videos (MP4, MKV, MOV, AVI) and external subtitle files (.srt, .ass, .vtt) stored across your device.\n\nYour media stays strictly on-device and is never uploaded or shared.

If you enjoy using this application and appreciate the regular updates, please consider supporting the developer by buying me a coffee. Your support helps me continue improving the app, delivering future updates, fixing bugs, and providing faster responses to user feedback.
